about: West Lincoln is a township in Niagara Region, Ontario, inland from Lake Ontario around Smithville and surrounding farm country. Agriculture, rural hamlets, and a small township centre define the place—not a city or a lakeshore resort town. Highways 20 and 27 cross the township toward Hamilton and the rest of Niagara. About 15,000 people live in West Lincoln.
